stem: A box maker in Sialkot starts with a square sheet of cardboard. She cuts a 3-centimeter-by-3-centimeter square from each of the four corners and folds up the four flaps to make an open box with a volume of 300 cubic centimeters. What is the side length of the original square sheet, in centimeters?
solution: Let the sheet have side \(s\). After the corners are cut, the base is \((s - 6)\) by \((s - 6)\) and the height is \(3\).
Volume: \(3(s - 6)^{2} = 300\), so \((s - 6)^{2} = 100\) and \(s - 6 = 10\) (the base must have positive length).
verify:
s=symbols('s',positive=True)
sol=[v for v in solve(Eq(3*(s-6)**2,300),s) if v>6]
assert sol==[16]
assert Rational(spr_answers[0])==16
